floorPlans.label: Emaar Montura 2 original floor plans
floorPlans.introduction: Compare two three-bedroom and two five-bedroom villa designs. The three-bedroom plans show two floors and the five-bedroom plans show three.
floorPlans.note: The selected floor plan includes its key plan, suite, outdoor area and carport. Confirm the signed area and plot for your villa.

review.images: Reviewed the official wide image and all six gallery images. Omitted the narrower repeat of the dusk hero. Three gallery images are byte-identical with Montura 3, and a shared frontage matches the Montura 3 hero scene. Shared captions preserve scope.
review.location: Checked the named developer point, cluster map on physical page 6 and the brochure estimates on physical page 5. Brochure and general community site estimate scopes differ. Community comparison: https://www.emaar.com/en/our-communities/grand-polo-club-and-resort
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all five pages. Four Montura 2 sheets were retained and each visual area panel was read separately because its figures were not extracted as text. The two 3 BR and two 5 BR types reconcile within 0.01 sq ft.

unavailable: Signed unit-specific areas and entrance-level routes were not verified.
